summary: Updates Nodemailer and the gRPC dependency embedded in Cosign to clear backend and plugin toolchain security vulnerabilities.
userImpact: Email delivery and plugin installation retain their existing configuration and interfaces.

instructions: Upgrade the backend and use plugin installer 0.2.9 and Plugin Manager 0.1.9 with their matching Helm charts.

security: Nodemailer 9.1.1 fixes GHSA-2x7j-588g-ccc2 and the related address-validation and message-access-policy advisories.
Both Cosign binaries are rebuilt with google.golang.org/grpc 1.83.2 to fix CVE-2026-84445; the build verifies the embedded dependency version.
HIGH and CRITICAL image vulnerability gates remain enforced.
documentation: The toolchain container notices identify the patched gRPC build dependency.
rollback: Restoring earlier images reintroduces the security findings; prefer a forward fix. No database rollback is needed.
validation: Email service regression tests, toolchain release policy, dependency notices, release-note preflight, and local production-image vulnerability scans.
